create_realsense_camera: create a RealSenseCamera instance with custom width, height, and fps parameters
get_frame_rgb_depth: call get_frame on a RealSenseCamera to retrieve synchronized RGB and depth numpy arrays
release_camera_resources: call release on a RealSenseCamera to stop the pipeline and free camera resources
test_realsense_streaming: run the test function to preview live color and depth frames from a RealSense camera
run_realsense_main: run the module directly to start a RealSense camera preview loop with color and depth visualization
